about: Aids to navigation per waters. A row's place is one of: osm [lat, lon] alone (the waters' projection), on: 'channel' with along (m from the channel's bay end) and off (m from its line; the side from the colour: red right returning, red to starboard entering from the lake), or at [x, z] (world m, a design placement). Red and green rows on the channel keep the source's lat, lon in osm beside the placed spot. Each row names its source; light strings are the light list's (Fl = one flash a period).
